integrity: All exhaustive enumeration source files, explicit certificate, and both recorded outputs are included in the same package. Computational algorithms prove a finite enumeration when their exhaustive branching and consistency checks are checked; no external audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the 20-vertex flower snark only; four-cover minimum and doubled-edge matching lemma were previously known; publication-priority uncertainty remains for unindexed computational records; no larger-family theorem.
title: Forty-two exchange components of optimum four-matching covers of the flower snark \(J_5\)
